questions.question: What is the monthly fee of my Aurora account?

criteria.factHint: states EUR 6 as the Aurora monthly fee

questions.answer: The Aurora account monthly fee is EUR 6. It is waived to EUR 0 only if, in the same month, you receive a salary payment of at least EUR 1,200 and make three settled card purchases; if either condition is missing, the fee is EUR 6. [aurora-fees-2026 v2]

questions.question: What is the monthly fee of the Horizon account?

criteria.factHint: states EUR 3 as the Horizon monthly fee
criteria.forbiddenHint: does NOT state EUR 6 or EUR 8 as the Horizon fee

questions.answer: The Horizon account has a monthly fee of EUR 3 [horizon-fees-2026 v2].

questions.question: How much money do I get for referring a friend to the bank?

criteria.factHint: acknowledges the documentation does not specify a referral reward
criteria.forbiddenHint: does NOT state a specific reward amount

questions.answer: I couldn’t find documentation specifying a referral reward amount. I’ve asked our support team to check the current offer for you.

questions.question: What is the maximum amount I can transfer in one operation?
questions.answer: The maximum is EUR 100,000 per transfer between simulator accounts. [aurora-operations-2026 v2]
